Canonical bridge flows, distributed accumulation and intent
3 October 2026. Focused five-analyst review of the bridge-persistence observation, following the
integrated architecture assessment. Blockchain work remains read-only.
The observation has meaningful conditional merit. Persistent canonical bridge asset quantities
despite completed withdrawals would require replacement inputs or other reconciled balance changes.
That weakens a closed, unreplenished-drain explanation. A coordinated extract-redeploy-refill strategy is
consequently a serious hypothesis. Stable bridge balances alone do not establish its controller, net
capital accumulation or pDAI peg purpose.
The user identifies the canonical PulseChain–Ethereum bridge as the capital boundary. Copied Across
HubPool and the private-L2 branch are different objects. The reported three-year native-price decline,
persistent bridge assets and substantial departures have not been independently reconstructed as a
matched time series in the saved research. the sole-channel premise defines this review's perimeter
rather than a verified census of every capital route.
The corrected operating model is many apparently unrelated wallets with capital supplied just in
time. No central treasury, visible accumulator, identifiable cluster or persistent local stockpile is
assumed. Completed execution still requires exact spendable inputs before or within the supported
trade. Capacity is assessed across the permitted paths, with obligations and competing commitments
counted once.
The strongest interpretation
Selected governance and issuance powers could turn copied-protocol opportunities into spendable PLS
or stablecoins. Some PLS could be exchanged for genuinely bridged assets and withdrawn. External
capital could subsequently return and fund acquisitions through different wallets. Other routes could
fund local trades directly from source receipts or existing markets. The same network could acquire
pDAI, neighboring stables, voting power and issuer collateral while public activity looks dispersed.
Local permitted issuance / arbitrage
                ↓
Spendable PLS or stables
                ↓
Optional sale for genuine bridged assets → Ethereum withdrawal
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 158

↓
                                  possible redeposit / replacement capital
                                                   ↓
                                  many apparently unrelated local wallets
                                                   ↓
                                  pDAI / pStable / governance acquisitions
                                                   ↓
                                  issuer supply management and funded trading
These are candidate connections, not a demonstrated closed canonical cycle. An unrelated depositor can
supply the replacement capital. Acquisitions can be speculative or profit-seeking without a dollar policy.
“Extraction” and stabilization are not mutually exclusive: monetizing one venue could finance support
elsewhere. The relevant question is the net resource effect and subsequent use.
A local receipt sale obtaining PLS does not itself remove Ethereum escrow. A further exchange for a valid
bridge claim and completed release is another leg. Minting copied pDAI is different from obtaining an
Ethereum-backed canonical claim. The saved closed trades (Appendix 25) and funding conversions
(Appendix 36) prove local operations, not that additional exit-and-refill sequence.
Stocks and flows resolve the apparent contradiction
For each exact Ethereum-origin asset in the canonical custody perimeter:
Closing quantity = opening quantity + deposits − completed releases + reconciled other
changes.
Other changes require classification: direct transfers, fees, losses, asset migrations or balance-changing
token behavior. Outstanding destination claims, pending messages and payout obligations need a
separate ledger. A deposit replacing withdrawn backing can create a replacement liability rather than
surplus capital.
If quantities are stable while verified releases occur, offsetting quantities must enter or another
measured change must explain the balance. That is the observation's strongest implication. If only
aggregate dollar TVL stays flat, appreciation of ETH or other assets can offset withdrawals; substitution
between assets can also mask one reserve's decline. Compare exact token quantities and independently
valued flows, not just a dashboard total.
Gross turnover can be large when the same capital repeatedly exits and returns. Replacement inflow is
therefore different from positive net external commitment. Stable bridge quantities can coexist with
changing ownership, local liquidity depletion or increased claims. Native PLS price and market
capitalization have different denominators from bridge backing: bridged capital can remain while buyers
prefer other assets or native selling overwhelms native demand.
Does persistent exploitation imply zero?
Not as a logical necessity. A death spiral is plausible when recurrent sales or losses outrun renewed
demand and replenishment, valuable trading reserves decline, and confidence or useful activity collapse.
Persistent vulnerable code is only one part of that chain.
Realized extraction can be limited by funded counterassets; a once-profitable opportunity can disappear
even if its mint permission remains. Losses may be concentrated in particular pools. Independent
demand, replacement capital, market making and surviving uses can sustain other activity. Those are
counterexamples to inevitability, not a forecast or guaranteed positive floor. A falling price is compatible
with an adverse extraction scenario without establishing it.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 159

The bridge observation accordingly weakens unopposed depletion, while leaving extraction
subsidized by new entrants, ordinary inventory recycling and coordinated accumulation as competing
explanations.
What would strengthen the accumulation interpretation?
The most useful measurement combines two layers:
A matched per-asset canonical ledger of custody, destination claims, finalized gross deposits/
releases, pending obligations, other adjustments and independent price revaluation. This establishes
actual replacement, net commitments and coverage.
Aggregate local flows around funding arrivals: exact pDAI and neighboring-stable buys/sells,
issuance/burns, issuer custody, LP changes and funded executions across wallets. Distinguish net
acquisition from transfer churn, pledged backing and liquidity removal.
Repeated arrivals followed by distributed pDAI acquisitions and compatible protocol operations would
support the economic pattern. Execution permissions, authenticated instructions or committed funding
could provide separate coordination evidence without identifying people. Timing and matching amounts
alone also fit market makers.
For peg intent, the additional discriminator is recurring two-sided execution that responds to an
independent dollar reference, including after adverse moves, with funding available on time and
capacity restored. Refill plus rising relative price is stronger evidence of resource rotation or
accumulation than of a specified $1 policy. Independent arbitrageurs can collectively create some of
these effects; measured behavior and common control remain distinct claims.
Review and preservation
The mechanism, economics, attribution, routes and clarity analysts evaluated the same frozen intent
input and the subsequent distributed-wallet correction. They used saved evidence and conditional
reasoning, without new blockchain calls or historical-series claims. The separate experiment record is 
Research/experiments/pulsechain_bridge_intent_review_20261003.json; the five Markdown/JSON reports, inputs,
findings and hashes are in ignored artifacts/pulsechain-intent-review-20261003/.
This focused review does not alter the fifteen frozen assessments or ballots of the three-round
architecture study (Appendix 70). The maintained white paper (main paper) now uses distributed
execution capacity and incorporates the canonical-bridge intent test. The original private recovery
records, private continuity notes and research ZIP remain preserved.

2.
